xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5504: docs: accuracy audit, Guides and Reference (16 pages)

plan.title: docs: accuracy audit, Guides and Reference (16 pages)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Every item edits one Mintlify page under guides/ or reference/; the finalize lint counts each page as its own subsystem, so 18 pages read as 18 subsystems. The epic (#5467) scopes one audit issue per docs nav group, and the pages share one validation pass and one PR body, so splitting into sibling issues would duplicate the validator and PR-body work without adding review isolation. The plan touches exactly 18 files, under the 25-file limit.

narratives.Problem: The Guides and Reference docs pages contain wrong, stale and removed-feature claims (old Traefik layout, a prompt loader described as owning every prompt, a support list missing four harnesses, the deleted state layer and re-trigger service, a token report from May), en and em dashes, generic titles and one broken anchor. The feature inventory checked coverage, not accuracy.
narratives.Proposal: The planning session audited 18 pages (the 17 in the two nav groups plus the Roadmap page template-conversations) against code on base 574a6be2c29 and wrote per-page change tables with grep anchors, replacement text and code evidence into .pan/drafts/PAN-5504.md (Appendices A to H). One item per page, three chained section items for each page over 600 lines, then one validation item that runs lint, the two tests that read these pages, mint validate and mint broken-links --check-anchors, and drafts the PR body with one note per page.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No code, test, rule, docs.json, CLAUDE.md, README.md or changelog.d change; code bugs become PR-body Follow-ups.
- No page outside the 18 in scope (vision belongs to #5499).
- No new pages, navigation changes, file renames or slug changes.
- No heading renames or deletions except those listed in the PRD's NFR-2.
- No screenshots added, replaced or recaptured and no image files deleted; only alt text changes and the ThemedImage removals listed in FR-8.
- No help section added to pages without a troubleshooting or help section.
- No web research; third-party claims stay unless repo code contradicts them.
- No description of intended behavior as current.
- reference/template-conversations.mdx must not drop its statement that pan bundle and pan template do not exist.

autoDecisions.summary: Audit 18 pages (the 17 in the Guides and Reference nav groups plus reference/template-conversations), not only the 16 listed
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's scope sentence is every published page in the groups; guides/operating and reference/settings were added on 2026-11-18 and no sibling audit issue covers them; PAN-5501 to PAN-5503 made the same call.

autoDecisions.summary: Audit god-view and template-conversations on top of the merged PAN-5472 and PAN-5482 results
autoDecisions.rationale: Both PRs merged and their commits are in each page's history.

autoDecisions.summary: Add the Discord and GitHub Issues sentence only to pages with a troubleshooting or help section
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for the links where a page talks about getting help; docker-setup, stitch-integration and prompts are the pages with such a section and no links.

autoDecisions.summary: Delete ThemedImage blocks that show removed UI; keep old-brand images whose content matches; list recaptures as Follow-ups
autoDecisions.rationale: A screenshot of removed UI is a wrong claim; recapturing needs a live dashboard and is outside a text audit; matches PAN-5502 D5.

autoDecisions.summary: Retitle harness-landscape, prompts, state-model and agents-directory with sidebarTitle keeping the old label
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for specific searchable titles; the issue's rule supersedes an older PAN-5483 'keep' note for prompts.

autoDecisions.summary: Rename the troubleshooting Vite heading to a slash-free form and link it from docker-setup
autoDecisions.rationale: The only broken anchor on main; a slash in a URL fragment is fragile across the local checker and the live site, and no other page links the old heading.

autoDecisions.summary: Paraphrase UI and CLI strings that contain an em dash instead of quoting them
autoDecisions.rationale: The dash rule applies to the whole page; changing the code strings is out of scope and goes to Follow-ups.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the short pointer sections the research proposed (MCP lane and worker tools, legacy orientation, pack MCP servers, shipped-since table)
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks to add what a user needs, briefly, linking the owning page.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep harness-landscape's third-party 'omp has no MCP' claim and skip rows 8 and 20
autoDecisions.rationale: Only one code comment suggests omp connects MCP servers; the PRD's rule keeps third-party claims unless repo code contradicts them, and confirming it is a Follow-up.

autoDecisions.summary: Split troubleshooting, prompts and harness-landscape into three chained section items each
autoDecisions.rationale: Each page is over 600 lines with 22 to 47 rows; section items stay reviewable and blocks edges serialize shared-file edits.
